prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objective “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on your case (injuries, fault issues, insurance limits), location, and what you want (maximize recovery vs. settle quickly). I can help you find a great lawyer for your situation. To start, here’s how to pick one and what to expect.

How to choose a lawyer
- Look for experience with car-accident cases (not just general practice). Prefer lawyers who regularly handle motor vehicle collisions.
- Board certification: In Texas, board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law is a strong indicator of experience.
- Trial experience: Lawyers who can and will take a case to trial usually get better offers from insurers.
- Track record: Ask about past case results for similar injuries and insurance situations.
- Reputation and reviews: Check Avvo, Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers lists, and client reviews — but treat them as one data point.
- Fees and costs: Most injury lawyers work on contingency (typical range in Texas ~33–40% of recovery). Ask how expenses (experts, court filing fees) are handled.
- Communication: Confirm how often you’ll hear updates and who your main contact will be.
- No pressure consults: Most offer free initial consultations. Use that meeting to evaluate fit.

Where to check credentials and ratings
- State Bar of Texas (verify license and disciplinary record)
- Martindale‑Hubbell peer review ratings
- Avvo and Google client reviews
- Super Lawyers lists
- Local Houston Bar Association referral

Important practical points
- Texas statute of limitations for most personal injury claims: 2 years from the date of the crash (so act promptly).
- Preserve evidence: photos, medical records, police report, witness contact info.
- Don’t give recorded statements to the insurer before talking to a lawyer.

Good questions to ask in a consult
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What’s your contingency fee and what costs are deducted?
- What’s a realistic estimate of case value and timeline?
- Can you provide references from past clients?

If you want, I can:
- Narrow recommendations to highly rated personal injury attorneys in Houston if you give a ZIP code or neighborhood.
- Provide a short list of firms and what to ask them in a consultation.
- Help draft an email or script to contact lawyers.

Tell me your ZIP code and a few details about the crash (date, injuries, if fault/insurance is disputed) and I’ll help narrow the options.
